text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: At the request of Isla, who had come to visit the Base World, {0} and the others visited Gio Gehenna with her~
text_block_list.orig_text:
基本世界にやってきたアイラの頼みで、
{0}たちは裏世界のジオ・ゲヘナを訪れていた──

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: IT'S HOOOOOOOOT!

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Unlike Salasaria, it's not the sun or the sand that's hot, but the whole air! It's humid! Hot! Amazing! Ahahaha♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
サラサリアと違って、
日差しや砂が熱い
っていうより
空気全体が！
じっとり！　
あっつい！　
すごいな～っ！　
あははっ♪

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Thanks for coming with me today, Kishi-kun! I've always wanted to see what kind of place these Underworlds are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は付き合ってくれてありがとね、
騎士くん！
『裏世界』
ってどんな所か、
一度見てみたかったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: There's no place like this in any of the Replica Worlds, so it's kind of refreshing... But this heat is just too much! If I stayed here every day, I'd turn into a boiled octopus.
text_block_list.orig_text:
複製世界じゃ、
こういう場所ないから新鮮……
だけど、
この暑さだけは参っちゃうな～！
毎日いたら茹でダコになっちゃいそうだよ～

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kishi-kun, you think so too r-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
騎士くんもそう思う──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah! Newb Big Bro, spotted! Collecting you now♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ザコお兄さんみっけー
回収しまーす♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Geez, seriously~ Don't you know it's bad to just wander around like that? You're my Newb Big Bro, after all~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったくも～
ダメじゃん
フラフラしてちゃ～？
ザコお兄さんは
ぼくのなんだし～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Kyahaha♡ Juuuuust kidding♡ I just happened to need a test subject for my brand-new mech~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっはは♡
なーんて♡
ちょーど新型メカの実験台がほしかったんだよね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah,you don't get to refuse, okay~? Don't panic, just give up♪ Okay, let's go♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
拒否権はないんで～？
じたばたしないで、
諦めてくださ～い♪
じゃ、
しゅっぱーつ♡

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Kishi-kun was abducted?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士くんがさらわれちゃったーーーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: The strange car that kidnapped Kishi-kun entered this fortress...! Oh my, that cage over there...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くんをさらってったヘンな車、
この砦に入ってったけど……！
あれ、
あそこの檻……

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's really you, Kishi-kun. I came to save you. Are you all right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
やっぱり騎士くんだっ。
助けに来たよ、
大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Well, I mean, I was in a hurry to chase after you. I did a full-on Isla-san super-daaaaash! And then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃもう、急いで追いかけてきたんだよ。
アイラさん猛烈ダーーーー
ッシュ！　
でさっ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Hey, we can talk about that later! Let's get out of here before they find us. The girl who kidnapped you might come back~
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
話はあとあと！
見つからないうちに
早く脱出しよっ。
騎士くんをさらったあの子が戻ってくるかも──

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: ...So I wasn't imagining things. A little thieving cat sneaking into our turf, huh? I don't know who you are, but if you've got business with me, show yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──物音がしたかと思えば、
ウチのシマに泥棒猫かい。
誰だか知らないが、
用があるなら堂々と来な。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: A thieving cat?! I can't ignore that! You're the ones who kidnapped Kishi-kun first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
泥棒猫！？
それは聞き捨てならないよっ！
先に騎士くんを連れ去ったのはそっち──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's the girl who was on the roadside earlier.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
さっき道端にいた人じゃん。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Are you making it sound like I was just "happening" to be there!? I wasn't loitering on the roadside, I was with Kishi-kun, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしがたまたま、
そこに居たみたいな言い方っ！？
道端にいたんじゃなくて、
騎士くんと一緒にいたのっ！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: And then you barged in and dragged him off! I'm going to take Kishi-kun back with me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを、
あなたが強引にさらってったんだってば！
騎士くんのこと、
返してもらうからねっ。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Kidnapped? Fubuki, explain. Why is the Boy in a cage? I was taking a nap so I don't know the whole story.
text_block_list.orig_text:
攫っただぁ？
フブキ、
説明しな。
なんでボーヤは檻に入ってるんだい。
昼寝してたアタシにゃ、
事情がサッパリだよ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Eeeehhhh? What a pain... Well, it's this, that, yadda-yadda, blah-blah, and so on...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー？　
めんど～……
まー、
かくかくしかじかの
ホニャララで～……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: So basically, Fubuki brought the Boy here because she had business with him. But he already had a prior appointment, is that it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり、
フブキはボーヤに用があって連れてきた。
だけどボーヤには、先約があった
ってことかい。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, what should I do about you, Fubuki. You could've just brought him here like a normal person. After all, the boy is my younger brother.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ったく、
しょうがないねぇフブキは。
普通に連れてくりゃいいじゃないか。
なにせボーヤは、
アタシの弟なんだから。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh?! Your little brother... Kishi-kun, you know... aren't you always someone's little brother or big brother or something? Is it just my imagination?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えええっ！？　
弟って……
騎士くんさぁ。
いつも誰かの弟だったりお兄ちゃんだったりしてない？
あたしの気のせい？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: There's no imagination at play here. One of these days, I plan to marry him off to one of my sisters. And then the Boy will be my brother-in-law.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気のせいなんかじゃないさ。
コイツにはそのうち、
アタシの妹をくれてやるつもりでね。
そうしたら、
ボーヤはアタシの義理の弟
ってワケさ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: She just says insane things like it's nothing, doesn't she!?
text_block_list.orig_text: さらっとトンデモないこと言ってるよこの人っ！？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Well, putting that aside... I get the picture. You had dibs on the Boy, so you came to take him back. I see, that makes sense.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
それはそれとして……
事情は分かった。
先約のあったアンタはボーヤを連れ戻しに来た、
と。
なるほど、
筋は通ってるねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Phew, that's great... Surprisingly, it seems the older sister is easy to get through.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほっ、
よかった……
お姉さんの方は意外と話が通じるみたいで。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh?! Do I really have to give back Newb Big Bro to her? Boo-boo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
ザコお兄さん返さなきゃいけないの～？
ぶーぶー

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it certainly does make sense. But you know... "sense" is left for normal people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
確かに筋は通ってる──
けどね。
それはフツーの連中ならってハナシだ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Do you really think the Bandy Sisters, the thieves' guild that silences even crying children, are just gonna hand back the loot they snatched?
text_block_list.orig_text:
泣く子も黙る盗賊ギルド、
悪逆無道を突っ走る【バンディ・シスターズ】が
分捕った獲物をハイソウデスカ、
とお返しするとでも？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: What my sister nabs belongs to us. Whatever she does with him is up to her... Isn't that right, Fubuki?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウチの妹が分捕ったもんはウチらのモンさ。
どうしようと勝手……
そうだろ、
フブキ？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, that's right♪ Well, in Newb Big Bro's case, he's always been mine~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーそー♪
ま～
ザコお兄さんは
元からぼくの
ってことで～♪

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: ...Are you saying that since you're a guild of thieves, you won't move along the conventional rules of society?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……盗賊だから、
世間のルールじゃ動かないってこと？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: HAH! If outlaws started following society's rules, the evil sun itself would throw a tantrum.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハッ！　
『無法者』が世間のルールに従ってちゃ、
悪のお天道様がヘソを曲げちまうよ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: I see. Then as long as we follow the outlaws' rules -- your rules -- there's no problem, is there? And there's a very simple way to settle this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう。
だったら『無法者』の……
あなたたちのルールに従えば、問題ないよね？
これ以上なく、
分かりやすい決め方で──

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, that look in your eyes... Seems like you're no ordinary person, woman.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ。
その眼──
ただもんじゃないみたいだねぇ、
アンタ。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: That's right. Strip away laws, rules, all that useless crap -- there's only one absolute truth left. Settling things by force...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうさ。
法だのなんだの邪魔なモンを取っ払った、
唯一絶対のルール。
実力行使、
ってやつさ……！

text_block_list.name: Isla Yamato
text_block_list.text: K-Kishi-kun?" "...Boy?

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Dangerous...? Even if you say that, negotiations have already broken down. This is the only way to free you, Kishi-kun...
text_block_list.orig_text:
危ないって……
そんなこと言ったって、
交渉は決裂しちゃったし。
騎士くんを解放するには、
この手しか……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Yeah, and it's got my blood boiling. No way I'm settling down until we settle this, fair and square.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
それにアタシの血も滾っちまったんだ。
もうキッチリ白黒つけなきゃ収まらないよ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huuuuh? Even I can't stop Sis Yama when she's this heated. Well... why don't you give it a whirl while despairing? *giggle*
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～？　
ここまで熱くなったヤマ姉を止めるなんて、
ぼくでも無理ゲーだっつーの。
まー、
せーぜー必死に考えたら～？　
ぷー
くすくす。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Fweh?
text_block_list.orig_text: ふぇっ？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Well then, Sis Yama and, um, Isla... san? Well, the half-naked cat eared lady over there. I'll be the referee. My helper will be Newb Big Bro, who I temporarily let out of the cage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
それではヤマ姉と、
えーっと、
アイラ……
さん？
ま、
そこのネコミミ半裸な人とで勝負やりまーす。
審判はぼくで～す。
手伝いは檻から出したザコお兄さ～ん。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: And the prize for this match is this same Newb Big Bro... *sigh*, I'm sluggish. Why do I have to play this role...? I was the one who caught him to begin with...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんで賞品はこちらも、
ザコザコお兄さ～ん……
は～、
だる。
なんでぼくがこんな役割……
てーか
お兄さんはぼくが捕まえたのにぃ～……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Fubuki, stop whining and get started!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フブキ、
グダグダ言わずさっさと始めな！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Okaaay! And what we're using for this showdown are my brand-new little mecha babies, fresh out of development and originally meant for testing on this Newb Big Bro.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
へーい！　
で、
勝負に使うのが～
ザコお兄さんを実験台に試そうとしてた、
開発したてホヤホヤの、
ぼくの新メカちゃんたち
ってワケ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Hey. Yamato-san, was it? Since this is a match, I trust we will be judged fairly?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ。ヤマトさんだっけ。
勝負っていうからには、
公平に判定してくれるんだよね？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: If anything goes, it'd be way too one-sided, right? Want me to spot you a handicap?
text_block_list.orig_text:
サマでも何でもアリにしちまうと、
一方的に過ぎるだろ？
なんならハンデをくれてやろうかい？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, I'll believe your words for now. So, what kind of match will it be?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……分かった、
ひとまずは信じるよ。
で、
どんな勝負をやるの？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: That's where this new mecha comes in~♪ It's called the "Bandy-style Gachapon Machine"~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこで出てくるのが、
この新作メカで～す♪
その名も
『バンディ式
ガラポンマシーン』～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Spin the wheel, and whoever gets the winning number wins! Easy to understand rules, right? Well, not that I'd mind if you kept losing -- I'd enjoy that more~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガラガラ
っと回して、
当たりを引いた人が
勝ち！
分かりやすいルールっしょ～？
ま、
ハズレた方が
ぼくは楽しめるけど──

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: So all I have to do is hit the jackpot, right? Then I'll take the first move. I'll go for a quick shot and win it all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
要は当たりを引きゃイイんだろ？
なら先手だ。
さっさと回して一発ツモといくよ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's not fair!
text_block_list.orig_text: あっ、ずるい！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way, you're first, Sis Yama? Wait, wait, wait! Sis Yama! There's still more I was going to explain...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
うそ、
ヤマ姉からやんの？
ちょちょちょ、
待って、
ヤマ姉！
まだ説明の途中……！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Look with wide eyes, AT THE STRENGTH OF MY LUCK...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
目ぇかっぴらいて見てな、
アタシの引きの強さ……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Now, the result...
text_block_list.orig_text: さてどうだ──

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Yamato-san is completely white! She's covered in some kind of powder and looks like a snowman... Fubuki-chan, is this okay!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁぁっ、
ヤマトさん真っ白っ！
粉まみれで雪だるまみたい……
フブキちゃん、
これ大丈夫なやつ！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Y-You're the one who said you'd go first, right, Sis Yama? S-So like... I don't think product-maker liability applies this time, sooo~ Or rather, please don't punish me~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やるって言ったのヤマ姉だし～？
製造者責任は
今回適用されない
っていうか～
おしおきは
カンベンっていうか～……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: *cough* ...Hah, isn't this interesting? We'll make it a contest of endurance and see who wins. Now. You're up, Isla.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲホッ…………
ハッ、
面白いじゃないか。
当たりが出るまで我慢比べ
ってわけだ。
さぁ、
次はアンタの番だよ、
アイラ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Yamato-san, you sure are tough...! But I won't lose in tenacity! Here I go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤマトさんタフだね……！
でもあたしだって負けられないんだ。
いくよっ！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Next up is the "Shock! Bandy Quick-Draw Quiz Machine"? Hmph. It's no big deal if the chair shakes or spins when I get it wro--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
次は
『電撃！　
バンディ・早押しクイズマシーン』だと？
フン。
間違えたトコで、
椅子が揺れようが回ろうが大したこと……

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Kh! Oi, pies in the face are banned! What a waste!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っと、
パイは顔面禁止だろうが
もったいない！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: "Giant Spin! Bandy Gourmet Roulette"? The plates spinning all around are making me dizzy, but if I can finish it faster than Yamato-san...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『大回転！　
バンディ・グルメルーレット』？
お皿がぐるぐる回って目が回るけど、
ヤマトさんより早く食べれば──

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: What's this? It's sour! And there are some strange flavors mixed in!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにこれ酸っぱっ！？　
しかも
変な味も混ざってるよっ！？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: This time, you've improved on the "Tickle-kun No. 3"... With the "New Tickle-kun Mk-V Custom"!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度は
『コチョコチョくすぐりクン３号』を改良した……
『シン・
くすぐりクン
Mk-Vカスタム』だぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: If I just steel myself, a little mechanical tickle attack is nothing, I'll just scoff it off and... ngh, wh-why isn't it working...! Ngh, huh... ngh... hahaha, this much is...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
気合があれば、
メカ椅子のくすぐり攻撃くらい、
鼻で笑って耐えてやる……
んぐっ、
き、
効かないねえ……！
く、
ふ……
んふっ……
ハッ、
この程度……っ！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: A match where the whole point is enduring tickling!? How is this even a match!? But I have to resist more than Yamato-san did... Kuku, ufu, ahaha! No, I'll lose points if I laugh~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くすぐりに耐えるだけって、
もうこれ
勝負じゃ
なくないっ！？
絶対ヤマトさんより我慢しないと……
くくっ、
うふ、
あははっ！
だめ、
笑ったら減点なのにぃ～！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hey, why am I participating in this too?! I'm supposed to be the referee here, aren't I?! Also I'm your Master, you know!? Listen to my orders you Newb Big Br-... fuhihi, fuhee, don't mess with meee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
なんでぼくまで参加することになってんの！？
審判ってハナシじゃ──
お、
おまえっ！　
ぼくは
ご主人サマだぞっ！？
命令を
聞──
う、
ふひひっ、
ふへぇ、
わらいじぬ～っ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Dragged into their escalating battles, Fubuki eventually faints. And match after match, Isla and Yamato...
text_block_list.orig_text:
激闘に次ぐ激闘に、
巻き込まれたフブキは失神する。
そして延長戦に次ぐ延長戦を経たヤマトとアイラは──

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's settle this for good. I won't lose if it's a drinking contest. The product we'll use is standard ale... no complaints, I take it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
これで決着といこうか。
飲み比べ勝負なら負けないよ。
ブツはスタンダードな麦しゅわ、
文句はないね？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Now that we've come this far, I'll drink anything. Yamato-san, cheers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここまで来たらトコトンやるよ、
あたしも。
ヤマトさん、
乾杯っ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: *Gulp gulp*...
text_block_list.orig_text: ごくごくごくごく…………

text_block_list.name: Isla Yamato
text_block_list.text: Seconds!" "Seconds, please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
「おかわりっ！」
「おかわりだっ！」

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Pwah! Ale really needs to be cold to hit the spot. It's been a while since I've sat down and drunk heartily like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷはっ、
やっぱ麦しゅわはキンキンに冷えてなくっちゃね。
こうやって豪気に向かい合って飲むなんて、
久しぶりさ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Yamato-san, you're quite the good drinker.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤマトさん、
いい飲みっぷりだね。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: You're no slouch yourself. You've got some real grit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタも中々やるじゃないか。
根性あるね。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Drinking side by side like this, it kind of feels like you and I are a little alike, Yamato-san.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんかこうやって並んで飲んでると、
ヤマトさんとあたし、
ちょっと似てる気がするなあ。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Hah! My condolences if you're anything like me. Stubborn, rough around the edges, and able to put away a drink on top of it. Heh, what a sorry set of traits to share.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハッ、
アタシに似てるならご愁傷サマだ。
根っこは負けず嫌いでガサツ、
おまけに飲める口ときた。
クク、
ろくでもない共通点だね。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you might be right about that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あははっ、
確かにそうかも。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Hey... Can I ask you something? Yamato-san, why did you become a thief? It's not because someone told you to or ordered you to, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ……
聞いてもいい？
ヤマトさんはなんで盗賊やってるの？
誰かに言われたとか、
命じられたとか
じゃなくて？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Of course I chose it myself. I've got no interest in living my life by someone else's orders.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分で選んだに決まってるじゃないか。
誰かの命令に従うなんざ、
真っ平ごめんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: So it's not because you're struggling to make ends meet or because you've been programmed to do so?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
生活に困ってとか、
プログラムされてるから、
とかそういうのじゃないってこと？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Naturally -- I choose my own life. What I drink, what I do, the scores I go after, everything. Sure, it doesn't always go my way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あったりまえさ──
自分の人生は自分で選ぶ。
好きな一杯も、
やることも獲物も、
全部。
そりゃ、
うまくいくときばっかりじゃないさ。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: But you know. It's only because I chose this life myself that I also accept whenever it gets me stuck. You've been living that way too, haven't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
けどね。
自分で選んだからこそ、
シクったときも納得がいくってもんさ。
アンタだってそうしてきたんじゃないのかい。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしは──

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: That's right, I too... made my own choices. Not that I had many options from the start...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
あたしも……
自分で選んできた。
選択肢なんて
ほとんどなかったけど──

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: ...Even so... even if the differences were tiny, barely more than rounding errors... they were still "choices" I made. And those choices brought me here, to this moment--
text_block_list.orig_text:
──それでも、
誤差のような違いでも。
あたしは確かに
『選択』をしてきた。
だから、
今ここにつながってるんだ──

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: I messed up plenty, and I've had moments where I didn't know what to do. But... as the "Administrator", I felt like I had to keep going.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしもたくさん失敗したし、
迷ったこともあった。
でも……
管理者としてやらなきゃ、
って。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean? I can't tell. Administrator or whatever -- you're really out here acting like some grand caretaker for the whole world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだいそりゃ、
アタシにゃ分かんないね。
管理者だか何だか知らないけど、
御大層に世間サマのお守りをするなんてさ。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: If you love doing it, that's fine. But... that job is over now, right? Isn't it time to get out of babysitting business?
text_block_list.orig_text:
好きでやってるならいい。
けど、
その仕事はもう終わったんだろ？
ベビーシッターは
廃業する頃合いじゃないのかい？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Out of business... I see, so it's okay for me to quit? I've never really thought about it that way...
text_block_list.orig_text:
廃業…………
そっか、
やめたっていい、んだ？
あまり考えたことなかったけど……

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Going out of business... Haha, that's true. Now that everyone is able to choose their own future, there's no need for a babysitter anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
廃業か…………
あはは、
そうだね。
自分で未来を選んでいけるようになったみんなにはもう、
ベビーシッターなんて
必要ないもん。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I've gotta start choosing my own path too -- freely, just like everyone else! I'm not about to let the people of my world leave me behind!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そっか。
あたしも、
もーっと自由に道を選んでかなきゃね！
あたしの世界のみんなに負けないように！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Maybe a bandit-ish lifestyle like yours wouldn't be so bad, Yamato-san... Maybe as a noble thief, or a bodyguard? Or I could go around hunting for tasty grown-up drinks~? I mean, I'm unemployed right now♪ Ahahaha.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤマトさんみたいな、
盗賊……
っぽい生活も
悪くないのかなあ？
義賊とか、
用心棒とか？　
おいしい大人の一杯探しもしてみたり～？
あたし、
今無職だしっ♪　
あはははっ。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: It's okay to throw it all away sometimes. If that's what you want, I'd be happy to hire you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たまにゃ全部捨てちまったっていいのさ。
その気があるなら雇ってやらないでもないよ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: If that happened... we'd be the three red-haired righteous thieves! That sounds kinda cool!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしそうなったら……
赤髪義賊、
三姉妹だね！
なんかカッコいいかも！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Ah, hold on... that wouldn't work. I happen to have a little sister who doesn't have red hair.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
そいつぁできない相談だ。
うちには赤髪じゃない妹もいるもんでね。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't that be fine? We can just downgrade Sis Bakana to flunky... Wait, huh? Where even is she?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いーんじゃん？　
バカナ姉はドレーに格下げ
ってコトで～
……って
あれ？
バカナ姉、
いなくない？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't she hiding in the car? Oh for... Wakana! How long're you gonna keep being shy? Get out here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あん？　
車ン中に隠れてんじゃないのかい？
ったく、
ワカナ！
いつまで人見知りしてんだい、
出てきな！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sis Yama. Now that I think about it, when we left the last town... was Sis Bakana even on board?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、
ヤマ姉。
そういえば前の街を出るとき……
バカナ姉って乗ってたっけ？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Didn't I leave the shopping run to you? And I was passed out with a hangover, so... Hm? Which means... maybe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
買い出しやらはそっちに任せてたろ？
それにアタシは、
二日酔いで寝てたんだから……
ん？　
ってことは、
もしかして……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah♡ There's a connection to the Shark's communication equipment~ Looks like we really left her in the previous town, after all. Well, whatever. Her whining and crying is annoying, so I'll just hang up~♪ *Touch*♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ♡　
サメちゃんの通信設備に連絡ありあり～
やっぱ前の街に置いてきたっぽーい。
まいっか。
キャンキャン泣いてうっさいし、
通信切っちゃお～♪　
ポチ♡

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Is it okay!? No, it's definitely not okay, is it!? You have to go and pick her up quickly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいのっ！？　
いや
良くないよね絶対っ！？
早く拾いに行ってあげないとっ！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Geez, what a troublesome little sister. Fubuki, get the car running.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく
世話が焼ける妹だよ。
フブキ、
クルマ出しな。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. I knew you'd say that... Seriously, it's all just unnecessary trouble because of that stupid, shadowy sister.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へいへーい。
そう来ると思ってました～……
ったく、
影薄い
バカナ姉のせいで
余計な手間じゃ～ん。

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Which means that's a wrap for today. Isla, we'll settle things with you next time. Don't go dying on me before then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってワケで、
今日はここでヒラキだ。
アイラ、
アンタとの決着は次の機会に預けとく。
それまでくたばんじゃないよ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Next time we meet, I'll maaaaaaake even more amazing mecha~♪ So look forward to it, Newb Big Bro~ Kyahahaha~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度会ったときは、
も～
っと♪
すっごいメカちゃんたち作っとくから、
ザコお兄さんも
楽しみにしててね～
きゃはははっ♡

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: So those are the Bandy Sisters... What a crazy bunch. So, Kishi-kun... I just realized something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれが【バンディ・シスターズ】……
とんでもない人たちだったね。
で騎士くん。
あのね……
今、
気づいたんだけど。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Could it be... that we're supposed to walk home from here? Actually, when I was chasing after you, I was so engrossed. That's why, um... I don't really remember the way home... Aha...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして……
あたしたち、
ここから徒歩で帰るの？
っていうか、
追いかけてる時は夢中でさ。
だから～
その～……
帰り道覚えてなくって……
あは……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, as the two freshly lost adventurers set off toward town, an even greater adventure awaited them... but that is a tale for another time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして迷子になった二人が街を目指して進む道には、
さらなる大冒険が待ち受けているのだが──
それはまた、
別のお話。
